scientific_integrity: The proofs are analytic and combinatorial, with finite exact computations used only for corroboration. Historical priority and all proof claims require external independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Total degree at most two, unrestricted full residue grid, and nonzero polynomial functions only. Determines extremal support but not every intermediate root count or all extremizer multiplicities. Historical literature comparison cannot rule out equivalent coding-theoretic presentations.
title: Sharp last-gap formula for quadratic polynomial congruences over every residue ring
